changes.description: Implemented locale support and added translations for titles and content abstracts.
Fixed an issue where certain tabs were displaying with an incorrect transparent background.
Added a folder structure visualization to item cards and updated provider location displays.
Improved general user interface components and display layouts for a better user experience.
Refined the pipeline visualization page and updated navigation tabs.
Resolved a database synchronization conflict occurring during system upgrades.
Introduced automatically generated system architecture diagrams and technical prototypes.
Improved the accuracy of source update timestamps to better reflect when content is checked for updates.
Optimized the release workflow to enable faster delivery of critical hotfixes and system updates.
Enhanced the internal verification process for stamped items to ensure improved data consistency.
Added support for OpenAlex data integration and original source tracking
Implemented Semantic Scholar integration for enhanced article insights
Added new article sharing capabilities and guest access mode
Initial release: RSS, ArXiv, and blog article scraping pipeline
Multi-provider LLM analysis with automatic fallback (Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter)
Admin panel for managing topics, scraper sources, and users
Automatic translation of analyses, tags, and tag groups into configured languages
Knowledge graph visualization with group and article nodes
Telegram notifications on pipeline completion with per-run stats
OpenTelemetry metrics and structured Loki logging across all pipeline stages
Added internationalization support for trace table columns and log dialogs.
GeoIP-based automatic language detection for frontend visitors
